question: Bismil starts from Point A and drives 14 km towards South. He then takes a left turn, drives 19 km, turns left and drives 16 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 26 km. He takes a final left turn, drives 2 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90° turns only unless specified.)
solution:
Bismil starts from Point A and drives 14 km towards South.

 
• He then takes a left turn, drives 19 km, turns left and drives 16 km.
 
• He then takes a left turn and drives 26 km.
 
• He takes a final left turn, drives 2 km and stops at Point P.
